# Performalytic — Full Site Guide

## Company Overview

Performalytic is an enterprise data analytics, AI, and DevOps consulting firm headquartered at 111 W. Jackson Blvd, Suite 1700, Chicago, IL 60604, USA, with a global delivery center in Patia, Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751024, India. We help organizations turn data into a competitive advantage through digital strategy, advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, business intelligence, and application development.

- **Founded:** 2023
- **Team:** 800+ data professionals
- **Clients:** 500+ enterprises, including Fortune 500 companies
- **Client satisfaction:** 99.9%
- **Projects delivered:** 10,000+ across 15+ industries
- **Contact:** https://performalytic.com/contact/
- **Social:** https://www.linkedin.com/company/performalytic-corp/

## What We Do

Performalytic delivers four core service lines:

### 1. Enterprise Solution Development
Data strategy, data architecture, master data management (MDM), entity resolution, data governance, and platform modernization for on-premise and cloud environments. We align business goals with modern BI-driven data architectures and design scalable, integrated platforms that unify data sources.

### 2. Advanced Analytics & AI
Machine learning, predictive analytics, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), autonomous AI agents, and responsible AI governance. We help organizations build production-ready AI solutions grounded in their own data — from RAG systems to AI agents that execute multi-step workflows.

### 3. BI Integration
Business intelligence implementation and integration across Power BI, SAP (SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BW/4HANA, SAP Datasphere), Snowflake, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric. We connect analytics with enterprise systems and data pipelines to deliver timely, trusted insights.

### 4. Application Development & System Integration
Custom application development, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipeline automation, schema compare and version control, and enterprise system integration. We modernize platforms and processes by embedding BI across operations.

## Key Solutions

- **AI-Powered MDM & Entity Resolution:** Build a unified, trusted source of truth through intelligent entity resolution, automated matching and merging, and centralized master data management.
- **Automated Data Reconciliation:** Continuously validate, reconcile, and maintain accurate data across all platforms, ensuring consistent alignment between source systems and analytics databases.
- **Data Quality & Observability:** End-to-end visibility to monitor data quality across all stages of your data pipelines.
- **CI/CD Pipeline Automation:** Streamline incremental database object changes through automated CI/CD pipelines.
- **Schema Compare & Version Control:** Compare and version-control database objects across environments.
- **Entity Relationship Modeling:** Maintain accurate relationships between core business entities such as Customers, Products, and Revenue.

## Products & Tools

- **4DAlert:** AI-powered data management platform for data reconciliation, quality, and CI/CD (https://performalytic.com/products/).
- **Data ROI Calculator:** Free interactive tool that estimates cost savings from better data management (https://performalytic.com/tools/data-roi-calculator/).
- **Tools Hub:** https://performalytic.com/tools/

## Industries Served

Performalytic serves regulated industries including Industry & Manufacturing, Transportation & Logistics, Healthcare, Banks & Insurance, Financial Services, and Non-Profit organizations, delivering data-driven solutions that address unique sector challenges.

## Technology Expertise

- **High Load Systems:** Scala, Java, Python, NodeJS
- **Business Intelligence:** Power BI, Tableau, Looker, SAP, Microsoft Fabric
- **Data Science & Machine Learning:** Modern ML/AI methods, neural networks
- **Data Warehousing:** Snowflake, Databricks, SAP BW/4HANA, Microsoft Fabric, cloud data platforms
- **Big Data:** Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Databricks
- **Cloud Platforms:** Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Oracle Cloud
- **Visualization:** Enterprise dashboarding and reporting
- **DevOps:** CI/CD automation, observability

## Engagement Process

1. **Business Analysis:** We establish business needs, analyze data sources, and gather requirements for end-user reports. Engineers create software architecture, estimate time frames, and design the BI system.
2. **Development:** Engineers develop BI solutions, validate results after deployment, and optimize performance using flexible architecture that supports lifecycle management.
3. **Lifecycle Management & Support:** Experts test big data at different stages, then support and maintain deployed solutions with flexible architecture for future improvements.
